title: Vademecum finding dictionary and loop policy
description: clinical-content/vademecum/findings.json: the canonical findings (history, examination, score and investigation items) that the disease-centred vademecum areas (clinical-content/vademecum/<area>.json) reuse across diseases, plus the policy of the hypothetico-deductive loop (lib/pane-engine/src/vademecum-loop). Phase 1: shadow only, nothing in production reads it. Read by the web loop and decoded on iOS (VademecumContent.swift through SharedClinicalContent). Checked by lint:shared-content (schema, Swift and TypeScript types) and lint:vademecum (references). Design: docs/VADEMECUM-PLAN.md.

lastReviewed.description: "unknown" until a named clinician reviews the content (never a date without that review).

status.description: shadow: run beside the production engines for comparison only (phase 1).

dimensions.description: The question asked for each dimension (the generated history questions group a candidate set's chips by dimension).

order.description: Position in the SOCRATES / history order (lower first).

priorTiers.description: Relative base rates (lib/pane-engine/src/vademecum/priors.ts PRIOR_TIER, the existing scheme).

criteriaFloors.description: Posterior floor when a criteria level of that grade is met (classification levels have none). The referral floor sets the test decision only (band), never the rank.

levels.description: The order the loop works through: history, exam, score, investigation.

pregnancyPossibleMultiplier.description: Prior multiplier for pregnancy-only diseases when pregnancy is marked possible (PANE PREGNANCY_POSSIBLE_MULTIPLIER).

defaultThresholds.description: Test / treat thresholds for a disease without a treatment-decisions.json decision.

cantMissThresholds.description: The same for a can't-miss disease (a lower test threshold).

criteriaMinPosterior.description: A definite / suspected floor applies only when the Bayesian posterior is at least this; below it the met criteria are reported as a conflict (a reading error or a finding that does not fit), and the rank is left to the evidence.

definitiveLR.description: Likelihood ratio given to a pathognomonic finding flagged definitive.

minLr.description: Floor of any single likelihood ratio (no finding zeroes a disease).

maxLr.description: Ceiling of any single non-pathognomonic likelihood ratio.

conflictLowPosterior.description: Criteria met but the Bayesian posterior is below this: conflict record.

conflictHighPosterior.description: Bayesian posterior at or above this but the diagnostic criteria are refuted: conflict record.

criteriaBonus.description: Added to a question's information gain (nats), times the candidate's probability, when its answer would complete or refute a criteria level of a leading candidate.

minInformationGain.description: Below this expected gain (nats) a question is not worth asking at this level.

cantMissSlots.description: Of those, the last places held for the most probable can't-miss diagnoses not already shown.

labSpec.description: A laboratory finding read from a structured result (lab feed, report import): the catalogue saved name (lib/triage-engine/src/report-import/catalog.ts), flagged with @workspace/triage-engine/reference-ranges.

multipleOfUln.description: At least this multiple of the upper limit of normal (practice range, else the default).

above.description: Absolute threshold in the catalogue app unit (value ≥ above).

below.description: Absolute threshold in the catalogue app unit (value < below).

demographicSpec.description: Answered automatically from the patient's age and sex; never asked.

ruleBandRef.description: A band of a clinical-content/rules/decision-rules.json rule (referenced, not duplicated).

label.description: Required unless the finding references an examination sign or a decision-rule band (their names are in those files).

chip.description: Short chip wording in the generated question (defaults to the label).

synonyms.description: Lower-case words or phrases that record the finding in free text (matched negation-aware at word starts).

baseRate.description: How often the finding is present among patients presenting in the pilot areas without a disease that lists it (predictive probability for the information gain).

group.description: Correlated findings (e.g. the inflammatory markers): within a disease, only the strongest positive and the strongest negative likelihood ratio of a group count.

pane.description: The PANE feature id (lib/pane-engine) that records the same finding.

examSign.description: clinical-content/rules/exam-signs.json sign id (its likelihood ratios are used, not duplicated).

entryPoint.description: The kind of entry point this finding can be: a case may start from it (the candidate set is seeded from the reverse index). null: it cannot seed a differential on its own.
